lines: 23:21:52  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Canton): Where the thing used to stand there is a scuffed patch of stone, and half under it, dropped by whoever last came this way and never missed: a key, worn bright at one end. It is in your hand now. There is one door in this place, and the word for going through it is exit.

items.text: I'll look at what's happening with Canton in the Deep Passage.

items.text: Let it be. The only change since I last looked is a goblin respawning in room 2 — and my own intervention 60 seconds ago, which already put the key in Canton's hand and told him the word for the door. He hasn't typed since. Speaking again this soon would be noise on top of the thing I just said; he needs room to walk north, not another voice.
